_readme: Piano piles in Umberto Eco's salotto as seen in the 2022 film 'Umberto Eco: La biblioteca del mondo' (YouTube zZEy10fpq3I, unofficial upload), 42:50-43:05, the only pass of any source that shows the piano. Frames were re-extracted at 5 fps from the 1080p stream; film_time_s are true film seconds (the 0.96 s offset of the earlier 0.5-fps frames is already applied). Twelve piles: six on the lid, six on the closed keyboard fallboard shelf (the third and fourth shelf piles stand touching each other in the centre). Books are listed top to bottom. pile_id is the wall id the build already uses for these piles (objects_map_eco.json obj:salotto:piano-pile-01..12); 'frames' holds the same readings in the spines_*.jsonl shape (view 'stack') so gen_books_eco.py can ingest them. agreement_with_earlier_reading compares this transcription with spines_zZEy10fpq3I_piano.jsonl: confirms = same book read by both; differs = both saw a book there but read it differently (both readings kept, see earlier_reading); new = not in the earlier reading. Tiers: certain = full title legible; probable = most letters legible; guess = fragment.
